messages:
sara: FYI the premerge job for PR #5172 attached a big group of findings from both SAST and DAST. multiple evidence blobs but no clear owner. anyone on the service team?

mike: I saw those alerts in the nightly aggregate. Most look like the same template-injection pattern we suppressed previously, but a few are new endpoints. Can you paste the failure snippet? :eyes:

sara: pasted below (from the CI artifact):
```
DAST: /api/v1/render?template={{payload}} -> server-side template error at line 12
SAST: tmpl_renderer.go:45 potential unsanitized fmt.Sprintf for user input
artifact: gs://ci-artifacts/5172/scan-report.json
```

oliver: tagging @jen from platform because this touches the render service. Jen — did we change RBAC or KMS access for the staging keystore recently?

jen: we rotated the staging KMS key last week and gave the deployer service account ephemeralDecrypt role for 48h. No other RBAC changes. Why?

mike: the DAST probe triggered auth-protected endpoints that proxy to render. If the auth token changed behavior it could expose a new path. But SAST points at a code path where user input flows into template rendering.

sara: security-bot just posted the linked evidence: https://redwood.ci/scan/5172 (bot summary: 12 SAST, 6 DAST, 3 high).

security-bot: Automated scan summary for build 5172: 3 HIGH (template injection), 9 MED, 6 LOW. Attached evidence: /evidence/5172/*.json. Consider triage workflow: assign owner, reproduce, suppress false positives, or open vuln issue.

oncall-sre: I'm on-call, can help with reproducing in staging. If KMS rotation affected auth it's worth re-running the scan with the previous keys to rule out config flakiness.

jen: we can temporarily re-enable the previous key for a quick repro window if SRE approves. That would need ticket and audit log entry. KMS rotations are logged in audit: https://kms.audit/redwood/staging (we should attach those logs to the triage issue).

oliver: proposed triage steps: 1) assign owner (platform) 2) reproduce in staging with previous key (SRE + platform) 3) capture KMS audit logs and access logs 4) run targeted SAST findings through local analyzer (rule id: RDX-TPL-001) 5) if reproducible, open P0 bug with mitigation plan (escape-harden templates).

mike: sounds good. I volunteer to be owner for the code-level SAST triage. Will run local grep and reproduce pipeline. Assigning myself to the SAST items.

sara: thanks. @oliver can you own the DAST repro and coordinate with oncall-sre for the key change window?

oliver: yes — will coordinate. oncall-sre do you prefer a 30m window now or tomorrow morning?

oncall-sre: can do a 30m window now. please post exact timestamp and I'll open ephemeral grant.

jen: I'll prep the temporary key re-enable and the audit log slice. Need jira ticket for approval — sara can you create one and link it?

sara: created RED-8721 and linked the scan artifact + audit link. added triage checklist in the ticket comments. https://redwood.atlassian.com/browse/RED-8721

mike: quick local repro notes (put here so we don't lose it):
```
# run local scanner
go run ./cmd/scanner -target ./services/render -rules RDX-TPL-001
# emulate payload
curl -X POST -d 'payload={{7*7}}' https://staging.redwood/api/v1/render
```

oliver: during the repro we saw the render endpoint return 49 in the HTML body — confirm template evaluated. DAST proof shows full template expansion.

oncall-sre: starting ephemeral grant now at 14:32 UTC for 30m. will note in audit and DM the key id.

jen: audit log slice attached to RED-8721. Also adding a note about least-privilege: the deployer SA was granted decrypt only, but template rendering uses decrypted configs at runtime — we should check if any user-controllable values are getting into templates.

mike: quick code excerpt (render handler):
```
func Render(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
  tmpl := r.FormValue("template")
  result := fmt.Sprintf(tmpl, r.FormValue("user_input"))
  w.Write([]byte(result))
}
```
This is obviously unsafe. I'll open a PR with escaping + template engine change.

oliver: good catch. That explains the SAST rule too. For DAST impact, we should add runtime checks to reject templates containing {{ }} or use a white-listing approach.

sara: action items added to RED-8721: mike -> SAST fix PR, oliver -> DAST repro & mitigation, jen -> KMS/audit evidence, oncall-sre -> ephemeral grant audit note. ETA EOD tomorrow for initial fixes.

security-bot: Reminder: any change to RBAC/KMS must be recorded in the keystore-change log and reference the incident ticket.

mike: putting up draft PR now with unit test and sanitizer. PR: https://github.com/redwood/render/pull/823 (WIP).

jen: after PR lands, we'll run the premerge scans again against a future build and verify suppressed findings are gone. I'll coordinate the re-run.

oncall-sre: ephemeral grant ended at 15:02 UTC — audit captured. Let me know if you need a longer window.

oliver: ran DAST sequence, confirmed template evaluation no longer happens when we reject curly braces at ingress. Logged repro details in RED-8721.

sara: great work team. Closing the slack thread — we'll update RED-8721 with final verification and postmortem notes (root cause: unsafe template usage + need for stricter ingress validation). :thumbsup:

mike: closing checklist: add unit tests, add runtime guard, update SAST suppression rules if any are false positives, and add a prevention item to the dev checklist (no raw fmt.Sprintf on user templates).

jen: I'll follow up with a short doc on KMS rotation checklist and how to correlate audit logs with scan artifacts.

security-bot: Thread archived to RED-8721.
